title: Fixed-floor canonical spectral definition of the Class-II K current
statement: For the hash-pinned A1 full-production q^-4 Gaussian field on the fixed three-torus, fixed eps_rho>0, embedded Pauli generators, exact spectral convolution, and any common real-even uniformly bounded scalar Fourier approximation converging pointwise to one with compact support or a uniform Schwartz tail, the smooth currents K_A,Lambda=omega_A(X_Lambda) partial_i X_Lambda converge to one regulator-independent canonical geometric/Stratonovich distribution K_A in L^p(Omega; C^(-1/2-kappa)) for every finite p and kappa>0. The K-level contraction vanishes in this class. Separately, the literal -delta_cube*N*W_eps subtraction with fixed lower-order coefficients is not cutoff-uniformly coercive, while two rigorously defined local bare proxies concentrate on the pure-third-component zero set with distinct scaling laws.
scope: CLOSED@FIXED-FLOOR-CANONICAL-SPECTRAL-K-LIFT on L=16 for the A1 production covariance, three complex components in the six-real convention, fixed rho_regularizer=1e-12, common real-even scalar spectral regulators, and exact/dealiased nonlinear products. The counterterm no-go concerns only the literal leading-W subtraction with pinned lower-order coefficients. Bare concentration is proved only for two local proxies, not the spatial Gibbs field.
falsifier: Failure of the resonant Fourier-Wick bound or admissible-regulator dominated-convergence argument; a nonzero same-point value-derivative contraction for a common real-even regulator; non-Cauchy sharp-cube/ball/smooth-even area tails; an incorrect Pauli curvature, W bound, zero set, N^(1/4)/N^(3/2) no-go scaling, or local-proxy law; source-hash drift; or any failed primary, independent, or integrated assertion falsifies the pinned closure.

reproduction.expected: PASS: primary (29/29); PASS: independent (16/16); ASSERTS: 64/64; A6-CLASSII-K-COMPOSITE-INTEGRATED-PASS; exit 0.

no_overclaim: This claim does not define J_A*K_A or |K_A|^2, close the Class-II counterterm family, prove uniform interacting stability or tightness, prove full-field bare concentration, construct a three-component Gibbs measure, remove rho_regularizer, cover arbitrary asymmetric regulators, take infinite volume, prove a phase transition or BCC state, or justify T6/T7.
next_action: Seek a stable renormalisation prescription with running relevant coefficients and explicit renormalisation conditions; in parallel, treat full-field bare concentration as a separate partition-function/tightness problem rather than importing either local proxy.
notes: T5 PINNED-CLOSURE@FIXED-FLOOR-CANONICAL-SPECTRAL-K-LIFT. The Fourier-Wick/paracontrolled proof closes K_A itself in the declared common-even class; the component-split asymmetric negative control shows why the class restriction is load-bearing. Literal W subtraction is refuted as a uniform-coercivity route by an exact homogeneous -Theta(N^(3/2)) trial.
